title: Dunn’s Word Cloud
content: Wordleis an online app that outputs a visual interpretation of certain key words according to the frequency with which they appear in a person’s writing.Here’s how Wordle interprets the teachings of the American illustrator and teacherHarvey Dunn(1884-1952), himself a student of Howard Pyle. (The writings are actually class notes by one of his students, Charles Andres.)Dunn speaks of “pictures” more than “paintings,” “spirit” more than “intellect,” “idea” more than “rendering.”MOREVideo:Meet Harvey DunnTry outWordle.netMore Dunn Quotes atArt and Influence(Thanks, Zeitwolf, Charley, and Armand)Harvey Dunn atLines and ColorsHarvey Dunn biography on BPIBHarvey Dunn: Illustrator and Painter of the Pioneer West
